evidence.detail: Class builds exact title 'Donation Shopping Cart Interface' with checkout, quantity, PayPal/OSRS-GP selection and bond values.
Exact bytecode builds interface root 60200, the same root later rebuilt by accepted DonationShoppingCartInterface rs/n/c/aw.
rs/n/d invokes C.a() first and later invokes aw.a(); registration helper immediately executes each builder, so aw replaces the same root widget tree later in startup.
rs/n/c/aw additionally exposes the registered rs/q/a/a handler path used by rs/q/a/a/b; C has no equivalent external handler registration.

candidates.note: Legacy/superseded is supported by exact same-root construction and deterministic startup order; it is not inferred merely from class naming.
